`search-music.json` is a trimmed real WEB_REMIX search response (fields the parser reads, nothing else; no
tokens, cookies or visitor data).
next-lyrics-tab.json, next-no-lyrics-tab.json and browse-lyrics.json have the shape of the real WEB_REMIX answers (recorded) with invented lyrics text: real lyrics are not kept here.

next-radio.json, next-radio-song.json (the watch-next answer with the RDAMVM mix: seed and mix tracks, tab ids) and browse-related.json (the Related tab) are trimmed real WEB_REMIX answers (titles and ids, no tokens or visitor data).

browse-charts.json (FEmusic_charts), browse-chart-playlist.json (the "Top 100 Music Videos United States" chart's playlist) and
browse-home.json (FEmusic_home) are real unsigned WEB_REMIX browse answers recorded on 2026-10-06, trimmed (tracking, menus,
overlays and continuations removed; a few items per shelf, 25 rows of the chart; no tokens, cookies or visitor data). A signed
home has the same shape (shelves of songs and of tiles); none is recorded here, as recording one would need an account's cookies.
